ctx.x: Then a plantation medley by the orchestra. Then, "I Gotta Robe", which again would have been a spiritual, sung by Carol Morgan. "Ramshackle Rag," by the orchestra. "Listen to the Lambs," of course a famous concert piece, by MRS H.K. Rieves, who was singing it, that is to say. "Exhortation" by Joe Porter. That was written by Will Marion Cook. Porter was obviously the singer --
